Cloud Desktop

Managed desktops, virtual machines and devices so staff work safely from anywhere.

See it in action

  • User signs in to Entra ID with MFA
  • Intune confirms the device is compliant
  • Conditional access opens the virtual desktop
  • A non-compliant phone is blocked until it is fixed

Illustrative simulation of a typical scenario. Not live customer data.

How we deliver it

Staff get a consistent, policy-controlled desktop on approved devices while company data stays protected. Access is tied to identity and device compliance.

  1. Profile users, applications and devices
  2. Build images and virtual machines on Hyper-V, VMware or Azure
  3. Enrol devices and enforce policy with Intune
  4. Apply identity and access rules and monitor compliance

Outcomes

  • Fast onboarding and offboarding
  • Company data protected on every device
  • One policy across the fleet

What we do

  • Configure Intune MDM: device compliance, restrictions and application management for laptops, desktops, tablets and Android devices
  • Manage Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory: authentication, group policy and user provisioning
  • Administer Hyper-V and VMware ESXi/vSphere: VM provisioning, resource optimization and high availability
  • Roll out endpoint security policies alongside device management
